scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
short_description: Special micro-credit facility providing collateral-free working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for urban street vendors.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
purpose: To facilitate collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods and incentivize digital transactions and timely repayment.

sources.notes: Includes 1st, 2nd, and 3rd loan tranches with DBT interest subsidy of 7%.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
Vendor must possess Certificate of Vending (CoV), Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB), or Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
Vending activity must be situated in urban or surrounding peri-urban jurisdictions.

documents.description: Identity verification with active mobile link

documents.document_name: Certificate of Vending / ULB Identity Card / Letter of Recommendation
documents.description: Official vending credential issued by Municipal Corporation / Urban Local Body
Required for direct benefit transfer (DBT) of interest subsidy and loan disbursement
